items.html: And this is what the verse says: 'He has cast down from heaven to earth the beauty of Israel.' For the Tifferet of Israel, which is ZA, cast down from heaven, which is the place of its Tifferet, the earth, which is the Nukva that was there in the place of the chest, as is known. And he also cast her from opposite his Netzach, Hod, and Yesod. And this is [the meaning of] 'and He did not remember His footstool,' which are his NNH. And she descended below, from his Yesod, in the secret of a single point alone, as stated above. And this is the matter of the verse 'and His kingdom rules over all,' which is explained in the Tikkunim to be the secret of the man of Assiyah, who was clothed in ten shells — she is the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut, called the man of Assiyah.
